name: Men's Sculpted Bezel Watch with Link Bracelet
description: A men's watch with a sculpted, thorn-like metal bezel around the dial and a chunky link bracelet. The tin or box shown in the photos is not included.

specs.label: Dial colours
specs.value: Red, Purple, Green, Black, Silver White

source.notes: Owner (3 Nov 2026): price 19000, cost CNY 38, five styles, copy says no box or tin included. Supplier Sgona Trading Company (Foshan; same shop as the octagon steel watch), 900+ sold, repurchase rate 34.21% (repeat buyers), 100+ added; return rate not seen. Title: Millennium Vintage Special-Shaped Paw Men's Watch Export Cross-Border Wholesale European and American Trendy Cool Niche Men's Watch; Paw, cross-border and niche wording left out (called a sculpted thorn-like bezel). Price CNY 38 for 1+, 37 for 10+ (about N8,452 and N8,229 at the app rate 222.4); unit_cost 38. Weight 300 g (owner figure, likely with the gift tin): shipping.weight_kg 0.3, estimated. Six styles on the page, five photographed and listed (red, purple, green, black, silver white); the sixth (a red cutout on white, 800 px, may be the red style again) not listed. Gift box: the supplier photos show a hexagonal black tin and a cream cushion box, but earlier listings from this kind of seller said Boxes not included: no box promised, owner chose to say no box is included. LOOK-ALIKE: the sculpted bezel and ornate bracelet resemble well-known luxury jewellery designs; no logo or text on dials; no brand named, hinted or compared. No size, movement or water-resistance figures: none claimed. Quartz likely (date window): button cell; ships_by_air unset like the other watches. Photos: supplier shots, 1200 px, cropped to 4:5; the tin and cushion show in them. The white-on-wrist shot, the duplicate red and the cutout are not used. Price raised from NGN 19000 to NGN 22000 on 9 Nov 2026 (owner approved margin review: 60% floor). Price raised from NGN 22000 to NGN 24500 on 13 Nov 2026 (owner: every price carries its freight and card fee and keeps 45%; weight-based freight estimate).
